newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish garment maker share issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish garment maker share issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Investors oversubscribed a tender for shares in Polish garment maker Lubawa SA, bidding for 781,900 shares of the 600,000 new shares on offer. The company set the issue price at 17 zlotys, it said in a statement.
The 600,000 shares were allocated to 1,282 investors who bid at least 17 zlotys per share.
The firm, seeking listing on the bourse's parallel market, had a 900,000-zloty net profit last year.
